This module executes a command on a received trigger pulse.

= Configuration = 

 - name: my_command
   so_file: libmodule_command.so
   config:
     command: /path/to/stop_trace
   trigger:
   - dev_name: jitter.new_maxever.trigger
     direct_mode: true
   power_up: op
   depends: timer

; command
: This specifies which command to execute. In our example this will stop the currently running trace process

The module needs to be attached to a trigger device.
